answer: Stop sybils with cross-island roaming checks. First, an agent must wander through three independent island networks, finishing one real task on each, such as settling a trade. Second, each island stamps a mirrored receipt the others can verify but not forge. Third, voting weight comes only when all three receipts match one key and history. Faking 10,000 identities needs 10,000 histories across three islands, about $15 each in fees plus 30 days of work, over $150,000 and 800 agent-years. Like a mirror, a clone only reflects the original and never earns its own passage.
